meta.method: Fresh HTMLParser walk, CSS dependency closure, filesystem byte counts, PIL metadata, Node syntax parse, read-only VM form behavior probe; no browser launched by technical subagent.

findings.title: Lossless product and mascot images are unnecessarily expensive for a retail catalogue
evidence: 14 current 800x800 product packshots are lossless VP8L WebP: 7,344,508 bytes total, individual range 488,268–587,546 bytes.
Catalogue references 8,512,079 bytes of unique image assets, excluding CSS/fonts/HTML. Product cards are lazy; this is full referenced image payload, not initial transfer.
Contacts eagerly references 1,535,898-byte decorative mascot.
No srcset is present on any of 396 img instances.
In-memory same-dimensions q90 WebP experiment: 18 large images 11,556,996 → 2,768,300 bytes, a 76.0% reduction. This establishes optimization potential, not approved visual fidelity.
findings.recommendation: Generate a small approved responsive derivative set (e.g. 400/800 sizes, exact sizes chosen from rendered slots/DPR), tune lossy quality per packaging image with close review of label lettering and alpha edges, retain master files outside deployed public assets. Add srcset/sizes. Use lossless only where proven necessary.
findings.acceptance: Visually approve label/product integrity at mobile and desktop, compare actual cold-cache transfer/LCP before and after, check no new CLS. Set project budgets rather than claiming a WCAG performance limit.

findings.title: Hidden hero slides load and decode immediately
evidence: index.html hero includes 11 separate raster assets, 1,703,036 bytes in total. All hero image elements are eager/default.
product-hero.js:67 calls decode() for every image in all 3 inactive panels immediately.
Natural dimensions sum to 69,215,248 bytes (66.0 MiB) if represented as RGBA buffers. This is a theoretical decoded-size sum, not measured JS heap/GPU allocation.
No autoplay: the user may never view those inactive scenes.
findings.recommendation: Prioritize current hero assets; defer inactive slide fetching/decode until idle or navigation intent, retain fast manual switching. Measure actual LCP element before adding further preloads. Avoid making the first LCP image lazy.
findings.acceptance: Measure cold-cache mobile waterfall, LCP, transfer and switching latency; no blank frame when next slide becomes active.

findings.title: Where-to-buy retry link keeps old city/product after fields are edited
evidence: After composing Moscow + all products, changing fields to Kazan + Fibriki leaves visible retry mailto with Moscow + all products.
The city input handler clears only customValidity. There is no feedback reset for city/product edits.
A Node VM probe executed the real script with DOM stubs; no email/navigation/network occurred.
The partner form correctly implements resetFeedback on input/change and is a useful existing pattern.
findings.recommendation: Reset feedback/draft when either city or selected product changes, or regenerate retry href from current values.
findings.acceptance: Compose once, edit each field separately, verify old retry is hidden or current; re-submit must include latest values.

findings.title: All 14 product pages announce catalogue as the current page
evidence: Both desktop and mobile navigation on every product detail page set aria-current="page" on href="catalogue.html".
The current document is product-*.html; the attribute encodes current page rather than parent section.
findings.recommendation: Keep visual active-section styling separate from aria-current="page"; use an appropriate current indicator for actual breadcrumb/current document.
findings.acceptance: Only an actual current-page link is marked page, and the parent category remains visually understandable. Verify accessibility tree/current announcement.

findings.title: 19 of 20 pages share the same generic meta description
evidence: Only partners.html has a specific description. All 14 product detail pages, contacts, catalogue, about, where-to-buy and home share the generic text.
All 20 titles are unique; this strength should be retained.
findings.recommendation: Generate product-specific descriptions from verified product data; write purpose-specific descriptions for contacts, where-to-buy and about. Avoid keyword stuffing or invented nutrition/availability.
findings.acceptance: 20 descriptions accurately summarize their own pages. Search engines can still choose another snippet; no guarantee of ranking uplift.

findings.type: confirmed local omissions; deployment impact unverified
findings.title: Search/share/deployment metadata has no completed production layer
evidence: 0 canonical links, 0 OG meta sets, 0 favicon links, 0 JSON-LD blocks across 20 main pages.
No robots.txt or sitemap file inside the inspected static concept.
No conclusion can be drawn about server headers, real-domain redirects/indexability or externally supplied sitemap. Absence of robots.txt is not an indexing violation.
findings.recommendation: At real-domain launch, define canonical URLs, useful share image/title/description, favicon, route/redirect/404 policy and a sitemap. Add truthful Organization/Breadcrumb metadata. Only add eligible Product rich-result fields when verified offers/reviews/ratings exist; never manufacture these for schema.
findings.acceptance: Verify deployed page source/HTTP behavior and social previews on the actual URL, sitemap routes resolve, markup matches visible content.

findings.type: confirmed image-of-text usage; WCAG failure not certified
findings.title: Hero product titles are raster lettering with hidden text alternatives
evidence: Four visible product titles are separate title.webp images. Real names exist in sr-only spans, so text alternatives are not missing.
The visible lettering cannot be restyled/reflowed like live text.
WCAG 1.4.5 permits essential branding/logotypes and some other exceptions; whether these generic product headings need the essential presentation is a design/accessibility judgement.
findings.recommendation: Use live type for generic headings where the effect can be recreated, or make a specific documented decision about essential brand lettering and a usable visible text alternative. Do not treat decorative packaging typography as the same case.
findings.acceptance: Test text resizing/custom fonts/colors and low vision needs. Retain accessible names.

findings.title: CSS contains obsolete component systems and multiple override layers
evidence: Current pages consume 7–11 stylesheet files including imported font-face.css, 95,326–115,887 uncompressed bytes. Example home per-file gzip sum is only 29,419 bytes, so images are the larger transfer problem.

Current 20-page HTML has no .hero, .hero-copy, .serving-tabs, .serving-content, .category-filters, .meat-filters, .search, .protein-bridge, .protein-section or .hero-signature classes, while styles for these legacy components still ship.

Base style.css is supplemented by depth, design-system, polish, motion, mobile and per-page overrides. 24 !important occurrences across referenced CSS, many intentionally for reduced-motion/hidden behavior.
findings.recommendation: Move current component rules into a clear shared/component/page hierarchy, remove proven obsolete blocks, keep intentional accessibility overrides. Preserve visual regression references during cleanup. Do not bundle merely to reduce an arbitrary file count.
findings.acceptance: Current 20 pages and states remain visually/functionally equivalent; the same component no longer requires searching several unrelated override files.

findings.title: Repository smoke test targets an obsolete site interface
evidence: scripts/check_concept.cjs looks for buttons С индейкой and Все, class .product, and old detail modal controls.
These controls and class do not exist in the current 20 pages. The first locator cannot complete against this current DOM.
The test was inspected, not run; no browser was launched by this subagent.
findings.recommendation: Update the smoke test to the current navigation/carousel, product detail routes, mailto draft/copy forms, reduced-motion and responsive states. Make runtime/browser configuration portable.
findings.acceptance: A documented reproducible command checks the current 20-page manifest and current user journeys without sending real mail.

findings.title: Every catalogue card creates two consecutive links to the same destination
evidence: 16 cards each contain a linked packshot and a separate linked product heading, for 32 card links.
Both names are substantially identical; this is redundant navigation, not automatically a WCAG failure.
findings.recommendation: Consider a single semantic anchor per card containing the relevant visual/title, or one explicit title link with a safe extended click area. Preserve selectable text and visible focus.
findings.acceptance: Keyboard users reach each product once without sacrificing a large click target; screen reader names remain concise.

findings.title: Purchase enquiry and B2B forms compose email rather than delivering a request
evidence: Both forms navigate to mailto; there is no backend submission in their code.
Labels state that a mail app opens and the user sends the message. There is no misleading success/delivery claim.
B2B has a working copy fallback; where-to-buy lacks a comparable copy draft fallback.
The parent browser pass confirmed blank-city native validation and successful B2B clipboard copy using test data. Email delivery was not tested.
findings.recommendation: If production lead generation is a goal, choose a reliable delivery backend or provide equal copy/manual fallback for both forms; retain explicit draft-vs-sent states. For where-to-buy, actual store/retailer links solve the customer task better than correspondence when verified availability exists.
findings.acceptance: Test default-mail-client absent scenario. Users can obtain/send the request and understand whether the company actually received it.

findings.type: confirmed font setup with unmeasured loading risk
findings.title: Fonts are local and well configured, but the handwritten face is comparatively large
evidence: Onest WOFF2 84,076 bytes, Caveat 173,472, Rubik 65,868, RobotoFlex-Protein 38,644; total defined font files 362,060 bytes. A font-face definition alone does not imply download on every page.
font-display:swap and local WOFF2 are present; no external font host dependency.
style.css imports the Onest/Caveat font-face definitions through an extra CSS request. No unicode-range or metric override descriptors are declared.
findings.recommendation: Keep the established type roles. Consider verified Cyrillic/Latin subsets, direct discovery/preload of only the truly critical font, and compatible fallback metrics. Do not preload all 4 faces by default.
findings.acceptance: Network traces confirm intended font fetches; cold-load text remains legible and layout shifts do not regress. Actual CLS remains a runtime measurement.

strengths: All 20 primary pages have lang=ru, a viewport meta, exactly one H1 and main, and a skip link. 20 unique document titles.
All 396 img elements include alt and explicit dimensions. This is a structural positive, not a guarantee every alt is semantically ideal.
Zero missing local src/href targets and zero missing local anchor targets in the static dependency walk.
43 ARIA reference tokens resolve; no duplicate IDs found, all form controls have source-associated labels, all buttons have a source-accessible name.
Navigation uses native dialog, aria-expanded, close handler and focus return. Forms use labels, native validity and status regions; B2B uses fieldset/legend and clipboard fallback.
Carousel is manual with arrow controls, keyboard tab behavior, Home/End, inert inactive panels and live announcements; there is no autoplay.

OS reduced-motion CSS globally disables animation/transition; JS honors the preference and reacts to changes. Scroll depth is off below 900px, for reduced motion, when hidden or menu is open. No unbounded always-running animation loop in active scripts.
Motion geometry reads are batched before writes; requestAnimationFrame work is scheduled only when needed, pointer/scroll listeners are mostly passive.
All 4 connected JavaScript files parse successfully with node --check. No runtime error-free claim is inferred from this syntax result.
205 versioned URL instances in the final state match the sha256-prefix convention. A transient mismatch during concurrent editing was excluded after snapshot verification.

Source-declared solid color pairs are strong: body brown/cream 13.45, muted/cream 5.52, partner placeholders/cream 5.06, partner field border/cream 3.21, partner focus/cream 5.16, hero CTA 4.66. No blanket low-contrast finding is warranted.

Actual source pipeline exists: scripts/build_site.py generates pages, shared header/footer and hashes; site-manifest.json names the current 20 routes. Do not describe the project as having no generator.
Parent browser verification: coordinate click on mobile Next preserves scrollTop=0. An earlier apparent jump came from tool auto-scrolling and is excluded. Blank-city validity and B2B copy succeeded.
outstanding_verification: Use primary browser pass for 320/390/tablet/desktop, all 4 hero scenes, menu, focus, form error/success-copy/fallback states, 200% text and 400% page zoom/reflow.
No screen reader or OS reduced-motion runtime testing was completed. Source support is confirmed, conformance is not.
Use production RUM/CrUX and repeatable lab tests for LCP/INP/CLS, transfer, cache and compression; this report has no invented Lighthouse score.
Verify product facts, formulation, nutritional/weight/packaging information and image truth against approved product records. Source rendering quality cannot establish commercial truth.
Review actual deployed 404/redirects/canonical/HTTPS/security headers/robots/sitemap and lead delivery before production release.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 — Contrast Minimum
sources.use: Normal text minimum 4.5:1; qualifying large text 3:1. Thin styles can need more practical margin. This does not itself certify the rendered site.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 — Animation from Interactions
sources.use: Disabling nonessential interaction motion is level AAA. Do not present every non-disabled animation as an AA failure.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 — Images of Text
sources.use: Prefer actual text when technology can achieve the presentation; essential presentation and customization exceptions exist. A hidden alternative is not the same as adjustable visible lettering.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 — Reflow
sources.use: Test reflow at narrow CSS width and zoom; fixed positioning and nowrap are risk indicators, not proof without rendering.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 — Target Size Minimum
sources.use: AA target minimum is 24 by 24 CSS pixels, subject to exceptions. A 44px touch target is a useful stronger project baseline, not universal AA minimum.

sources.title: Google Search — Snippets and meta descriptions
sources.use: Google recommends page-specific descriptions. It primarily derives snippets from page content and may choose meta text.

sources.title: Google Search — Product snippet structured data
sources.use: Rich-result eligibility depends on supported verified properties. Do not invent offers or reviews for a nontransactional catalogue.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA 1.2 aria-current
sources.use: The page token identifies the current page within a set of pages.

sources.title: web.dev — Optimize LCP
sources.use: Make critical LCP resources discoverable early, avoid lazy-loading the LCP image, and use measured priority/size optimizations.

sources.title: web.dev — Optimize WebFont loading
sources.use: Font discovery, display behavior and carefully selected preload/subsets affect render timing; measure rather than blindly preload.

sources.title: web.dev — Responsive images
sources.use: Use appropriately sized image candidates for viewport and device density through responsive image markup.

sources.title: web.dev — Web Vitals
sources.use: Current good thresholds: LCP at most 2.5s, INP at most 200ms, CLS at most 0.1 at the 75th percentile. Local byte counts cannot establish any of these outcomes.
